jolt.use: Two-pass common-cycle claim reduction, shared-Eq flat virtualization, compact lazy selectors and per-row arithmetic product tree; adapted to GF128 coefficient arithmetic.

leanVM.use: Algorithm/scheduling reference; GF192 representation and protocols are not substituted.

open_magnetar.workspace_note: Cargo.toml selects eight upstream crates. Cargo.lock is resolved for this subset; neither workspace file is a prover kernel.

function_ranges.role: Retained fraction witness levels, 3-multiply recurrence, reusable buffers, sqrt-Eq evaluation and folded layer prover
Rational root equality and sequential left/right fraction reductions
Square-root Eq evaluation with virtual constant padding and deferred reductions
Equality-factored two-statistic product sumcheck with in-place folds
Point reversal at low-first public boundary
Retained suffix equality-table layout; unused alloc helpers omitted
Endpoint recovery and equality-product relation check
Quadratic IP proving and terminal committed evaluation
Index encoding injects bits as polynomial coefficients

bitz_logup.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 over sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw 32-byte file SHA256 for each local_sha256 entry.
bitz_logup.fingerprint_scope: Cargo.toml, LICENSE, and every src file (including tests); excludes Cargo.lock, provenance/docs and target outputs.
bitz_logup.license_note: The donor retained LICENSE grants MIT permission; copied verbatim. Its workspace declares MIT OR Apache-2.0.
local_adaptations: K/U256 static field shim replaces F128/Wide256 without changing field basis or arithmetic formulas.
Typed proof structs and checked dimensions/round/layer counts replace donor stream deserialization.
Result errors replace invalid-input root/shape/denominator and zero-gamma assertions; terminal IP validation adds no full-table scan.
OM hash-chain transcript uses explicit label/domain/dimension and canonical field-message framing; this is a new wire format, not original-proof-byte compatibility.
Donor product loop retains high-variable-first scheduling and boundary reversals; every public point is OM low-variable-first.
Unused upstream grand-product orchestration, tracing attributes and standalone allocation helpers omitted.
Independent dense algebra/proof/transcript oracles added for native/default regression coverage.
bitz_logup.protocol_scope: Weighted rational pushforward and public-table inner-product reductions only. Caller must commit weighted pushforward before tau and authenticate every returned nonpublic evaluation.
bitz_logup.shared_dependencies: om-field and om-transcript provenance is recorded separately in vendor/open-magnetar/UPSTREAM.json; rayon is resolved by the caller Cargo lockfile.

notes: All warmup and measured proofs independently verified. Payload generation and ProveResult destruction excluded from prover time.

Inclusive main/aux commit/open durations are disjoint; remaining_ms includes IOP, witness/setup and statement preparation. Exclusive stage spans are separate diagnostics and must not be added to inclusive timings.
Both methods share identical public u64 ROM values and address traces with recorded SHA256 fingerprints, read_values=None. Guest-derived cases retain only addresses and discard RAM values/stores.
Shout chunk/virtualization choices are swept; LogupStar has one canonical case per pattern, unused chunk_bits=0 and Flat config. Ratios above1 indicate smaller/faster LogupStar values.
PCS profile names are not composed security guarantees. The conservative extra LogupStar term (T+N)/2^128 excludes other errors; equal overall security is not claimed.

logup_extra_bound.scope: Conservative extra rational-identity term only, conditional on a nonzero defect; excludes poles, batching, other sumchecks and PCS. Valid indexed addresses can give a tighter N-1 rational degree.
